errors.evidence: The description identifies the marker for the FT series as a 'triangle', but the legend and plot clearly show it is an inverted triangle.
The description identifies the marker for the MEMIT series as a 'triangle', but the legend and plot show it is a pentagon.
The final data point for the 'Base' model is clearly below the 45% grid line, at approximately 44%. The stated value of 45% is an overestimation.
The final data point for the 'FT' model is around 47.5-48%. The stated value of 49% is an overestimation.
The final data point for the 'MEND' model is approximately 56%. The stated value of 57% is an overestimation.
